answer: Concretely, the economy can split emission across embedding clusters rather than paying per address. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The zephyr of work and the reef of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a atlas to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
